answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 23292 Country: India Title: I am not getting job please guide me how can i get job easily? Question: I am not getting job please guide me how can i get job easily? Answer ID: 23292 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1026/1026/M=1431) Keep on searching for jobs. Offer fardh salah with first takbir of jama’ah. And after each salah, recite Surah Fatiha and Ayatal Kursi 3-3 times with durood 3-3 times before and after. Also recite Ya wahhab (يا وهاب) 100 times before going to bed. Also keep on reciting durood in your in leisure extensively. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
